items.title: TikTok Agrees to $400 Million Settlement in U.S. Child Privacy Lawsuit
items.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) announced on Friday that ByteDance-owned TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a 2024 lawsuit accusing the company of violating child privacy laws in the country. items.title: Named Pipes Under Attack: Securing Windows Interprocess Communication
items.description: Windows named pipes provide fast interprocess communication, but weak access controls can expose privileged services to untrusted processes. ThreatLocker explains how endpoint verification, command authorization, strict input validation, and narrowly scoped privileges can help secure named-pipe communication. [...]
